summary: All three Official Round 2 findings are closed. The canonical train metric schema fixes Recall@100, train, OUT, primary, higher-is-better, n, denominator, and dataset/config/retriever/evaluator hashes. The immutable baseline commitment must precede train outcomes and binds a repository-relative, non-protected, accepted P1 receipt through file SHA-256 and an exact metrics-array index. Baseline reproduction copies the committed expectation and tolerance and must exactly equal the baseline candidate ledger metric across identity, value, n, denominator, lineage, split, scope, and evidence role. Repository-only fixture execution is contract-safe under these static guards.

recommended_next_action: Retain the repaired contracts unchanged and proceed only with a separately authorized repository-only fixture pilot; do not start measured P2 or selection exposure automatically.
